Title: Kunal's Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 10 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Shalini - 34 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Aditya - 8 years, friend
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
4. Vimla - 62 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Shalini and Vimla stand near him.]

Vimla: "Shalini, what's the plan today?"

[Kunal feeds the dog.]

Vimla (happily): "Shalini, are you okay?"

[Kunal milks the cow.]

Shalini (surprised): "Hey, look at that!"

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Kunal: "That's easy."

[Kunal pats his horse.]

Vimla (surprised): "Yes, all right."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Shalini and Vimla stand near him.]

Kunal: "Let's begin."

[Kunal lies down on the sofa.]

Vimla: "What happened?"

[Kunal sits down on a chair.]

Shalini (surprised): "What next?"

[Kunal flops down on the sofa.]

Shalini (gently): "I'm ready!"

[Kunal sits cross-legged on the floor.]

Vimla: "What next?"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Kunal stands in the courtyard. Shalini and Aditya stand near him.]

Shalini: "What a nice place."

[Kunal opens his umbrella.]

Kunal: "This is amazing!"

[Kunal puts on his raincoat.]

Kunal (excited): "Exactly right."

[The rain stops.]

Aditya (excited): "What a day to remember!"
